finding.problem: The new blanket before-assessment hash rule and restore-on-change instruction also cover source assets intentionally edited by the trial prompt. Known-policy/current-results intentionally update the existing hash-bound stage summary. Restoring these authorized changes would overwrite the trial deliverable.
finding.consequence: A valid edit workflow could be treated as input corruption, and its retained output could be destroyed or invalidated.
finding.suggested_correction: Before dispatch, check every bound input. Before assessment, verify read-only inputs and preserve authorized edits as outputs with original and resulting hashes. Apply restore-on-change only to protected inputs.

other_checks: The missing optional reference recovery correctly requires exact pinned bytes and preserves availability limits.
No extra publication, deployment or native-client authority is introduced.
limits: Instruction review against retained real evaluation cases; no fresh model trial ran for this protocol wording.
